summary: Fixed the quoted-entry-disables-own-glob bug in both is_contained_v10 (git-commit-scoped.sh) and its ported twin is_contained (git-commit-phase.sh), so a /**-suffixed file_scope entry now contains its direct children and every deeper descendant without widening containment for any non-/** entry or same-prefix sibling. Added and verified six new test cases across both suites (Z11-Z14, Case 10-11), each independently confirmed RED against pre-fix behaviour, then restored cleanly. Redeployed via deploy-headless.sh; the complete gate set was deferred to the batch-level stage per this dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, with the scoped narrowing invocation (both touched suites) passing cleanly against the deployed tree.
